name: system-deep-loop
description: Unified deep-loop parent hub: the single advisor-routable home for active deep-loop personas, routing to two modes across two workflow families over a nested runtime/ infrastructure layer (formerly the separate deep-loop-runtime skill, merged 2026-07-08). research (outward web+code iterative investigation → research/ artifacts), review (iterative review loop → P0/P1/P2 findings + verdict).
